notes: Passionate, driven teacher - the lead voice
Paul before his conversion - the same voice, harder
Son of Encouragement - warm and steady
Worldly, restless - the one who leaves
Teacher and host - the one woman who speaks
Elder disciple of Damascus - steady, unafraid
One of the Seven - witnessed Stephen's death
One of the Seven, a convert from Antioch - hopeful
The voice from heaven on the Damascus road - slow, calm, weighty
